items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport. Use V.A.T.S. to target the leg.

items.title: Eat a Plant-based Meal
items.detail: Cook Corn Soup at a Cooking Station and consume it.

items.title: Eat a tin of Cram
items.detail: Found in Summersville diner kitchen or west of Mosstown.

items.title: Gain XP
items.detail: Complete kills, events, or raid activities. West Tek is a fast grind.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suit scraps or excavator power armor mod boxes.

items.title: Sell Mutant Hound Chops to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Kill a Mutant Hound at Sunnytop Ski Lanes, then sell chops at any vendor.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go or Grafton Steel.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops team or start one. Easier with a team.

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build one at your C.A.M.P. or use the one at Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Spooky Scorched appear during the seasonal event. Morgantown Airport is reliable.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense Feral Ghouls.

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume item and go to Poseidon Energy Plant.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt Spooky Scorched enemies wearing Halloween costumes and masks for exclusive rewards and seasonal challenges.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend-long event.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE points and extra caps during this weekend event.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special anniversary celebration with unique challenges and rewards.
